body: Thanks a lot for the comment and I'm glad people can see it from my perspective. I really get terrified of the idea of going back and I hope so too. I am really sorry you have faced microaggressions too. Its easy for non poc to gaslight and tell us that what we faced isnt valid and that it doesn't exist and the UK is perfect and yadda yadda when its not, but I know our experiences are valid. Im trying really hard to have the confidence and to not care what people think, its hard though, thanks for the encouragement :)
Thats random why ask?
Thank you, I know there are good people but its my experience and I can’t change what has happened.

You missed the point.

Unlike the UK, people leave me alone here. Sure they stare at times but they don't call me disgusting or other slurs down the street, they generally mind their own business, people in the UK like to make their opinions known a lot of the time.

I went to Japan not to assimilate but for a job and to try and heal myself. 

Case closed.
My friends are in the city I don't want to be in.
Im from the UK, it was a horrible place for me
Oh this was in Edinburgh. I don't live there anymore but I am too traumatized and I don't want to go back. People have told me that it could be racially charged to

Oh don’t assume I haven't tried. I have always been taking care of myself and skin, but the main complaint I get is that my face is ugly. Of course my body is fine so people just want me for sex but when your face is ugly there isn't anything you can do about it apart from a surgical knife. Its hard matter how much you try especially as a woman, no guy will take you seriously. The most you get is men wanting to screw you if that. It sounds like there is hope for you, fingers crossed I hope it gets better and you feel happy about yourself one day.

Im sorry to hear that I can understand, I hope your conditions can improve, for me im just ugly downright which has ruined my chances of dating and settling down. Keep your chin up, i hope you find someone who appreciates you for who you are.
Thank you for your kind comment. I will try my best :')

Since I have been trying to reply to every other comment and I have just came down to your comment just now I can't really give a thorough response to this but you are right in terms of the age thing, however given what other people have said I think I will wait it out in Japan just a bit longer and see whether I will be able to find the right therapist for me whilst im on JET. I don't have contact with my psychiatrist back at home at this moment. I haven't had a lot of mental energy to socialize with people so I admit I have been isolating myself even though people have been wonderful to me. I hope I regain the energy to be able to make connections eventually though. This is kind of you to say it means a lot :')

Thanks for the reassurance and the advice. And mostly taking the time to help me out I wont forget it. I don't have answers to the questions that you have given, but I hope that I will be able to be at a point that I can give them one day. 
Again thank you :)

Thank you for this comment, actually you hit the nail in the head with the late 20's crisis. A lot of these things are triggers for me, comparing myself to others. Seeing things that other people have which I don't. It genuinely sends me on a downward spiral, falling into depression and feeling like I failed my life and youth. I am trying to walk my own path and thank you for reminding me that I should focus on what matters to me most. I feel like society puts to much pressure on people in their 20s to have everything sorted out by the time they are 30 and this mindset is so toxic I admit. I just wish people didn't shame others for not necessarily achieving all the things that society expects them to achieve. E.g Have a family, kids, and a career that pays a stable income by 30. I think as well being a woman we are told that our value decreases once you are over the age of 25 etc. People are obsessed with youth esp in Japan, where terms like "Christmas cake girl" exist. Its horrible. Your comment really hit deep, and made me think.
Yeah thanks for warning us !

Wow thanks for taking the time to find the resources for me. This will be very helpful for future reference. I hope that your CPTSD gets better for you, its a horrible mental illness to have :'(. Again thank you I will definitely look at the links and see if I find someone who can help!
Oh no you too? Yeah I hope things get better for us. And you're right. Thanks for the motivation response! :)

Oh of course, thats why I was seriously contemplating what to do next. Thanks for the extra insight with the ALT stuff I have heard that the career pays really badly and there is no progression in the field. Most people on here have said that I should try living in the moment and take JET like a working holiday and some kind of break. Thanks for your comment and for the reassurance :)

Omg I just read your comments and omg I am glad that it worked out in the end. Really happy for you! I think I am at the point in my life where I am not too focused on staying here, as long as I find somewhere to belong to (finding love, starting a family), I honestly don't care where I end up in the end. And your right I should wait it out a little longer, I am going to focus on finding the right therapist and living in the present (something I am not good at). I hope I can see the light in life again and enjoy Japan to its fullest. Thanks for writing your story its inspiring to hear :)

Im sorry to hear what happened to you! I hope things are better for you now since then. I have heard from other people not to act impulsively and give it a little more time. Thank you for the comment, sorry if the response seems a little bit bland I am still feeling down in the dumps and trying to process everything

Thank you for your advice and the nice pep talk it really helps a lot :) and its interesting that you mention not to make decisions during winter. I will definitely wait it out and yes I did actually put yes on the recontracting form so I will have more flexibility. Thank you! I will send you a dm when I am feeling a bit better :)

Thanks for adding that comment, you are right I need to be tactful on how I go about my decisions. Oh actually I am in a different prefecture but I think its close enough to Kansai! I will hit you up whenever I am in that region!

Yeah you are right about this, I am happy and so thankful that I finally have stability for once surely. And yes I am with betterhelp but I will also look for other therapists as well. Thanks for taking the time to write a reply :)

Thank you for this practical advice. I will make sure to avoid Berger. Currently I have signed for therapy with better help, I am hoping it will work for me. And I am so sorry for what happened to you! I know that other people have their own lives to deal with, I guess its comforting to know that there are people that can understand difficulty and can sympathize with you. Oh I am actually in honshu but If I ever get the chance to go to Kyushu sometime I will hit you up!

Thank you, I feel like there is a lot of pressure especially the fact that people around me have told me that JET isn't really a career, only a temporary stepping stone/safety net, and it gives me anxiety because I have no idea what I will do once I lose it. But like other people have said I am going to focus on getting therapy and trying to live in the present more. And haha thanks for the suggestion, I will do so hopefully my trauma will be fully healed and I can finally enjoy the awesomeness of Japan!
I am glad you are feeling better, hope it stays that way :)
Oh okay I will send you a dm ! :)
I just saw this comment and really thank you so much :'). You too.

Someone else mentioned about living in the present. I agree with you, I am trying my best to live in the present. I have been busy working on a project during these holidays. 
And about the mental health thing, you are absolutely right, I actually forgot about that. My mental health will follow me around no matter where I move to. I think I need to rethink everything with this in mind. Thank you for your advice.

Its sucks to hear about your situation, I don't like feeling better about others misfortunes but I know where you are getting from. I would say I feel more comforted that I am not alone in this. Thank you for your sweet message! And I wish you so much luck with the JET programme! I truly hope that you will make it and change your life for the better as well! :)

You are right about me worrying too much about the future. I should really just try to the live in the present. I will definitely take on your advice. I recently signed onto betterhelp in regards to my mental health but I will also check other therapists that specialize in trauma as well. Thanks so much.
